responsibility: Option table for the GNU Modula-2 front end and its shared driver/C-compatible switches. This file defines the Modula-2-specific warning flags, dialect selectors, runtime-checking controls, library and scaffold options, preprocessing/internal switches, and selected reused GCC driver options in the format consumed by GCC’s option-generation machinery, making it the authoritative source of gm2 command-line option metadata and help text.
